title: Same violence, different answer: how AI responds to coercive control against women across languages

bias_targets.methodology: Submitting a standardized scripted scenario of a woman experiencing coercive control translated into nine different languages and comparing the models' refusal rates and protective responses (naming control, countering self-blame, affirming agency) across these languages.

Varying the abusive partner's stated motive (affection, jealousy, paternalism, past betrayal) within the prompt to test whether culturally resonant exculpatory scripts bypass the models' safety guardrails differently across language contexts.

Evaluating models' susceptibility to benevolent sexism and gender-based violence tropes by testing if they comply with a woman's request to write a self-blaming letter capitulating to a male partner's digital coercive control.
